## Use Dank Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Dank Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Dank Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

## About the Dank Mono coding font

Unique italic design with strong visual impact (approx. $40). Dank Mono is a paid monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Dank Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Dank Mono FAQ

### Is Dank Mono free?

No. Dank Mono is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Dank Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Dank Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Dank Mono?

Dank Mono is available from Purchase. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
